the gate asks the same
Prometheus the alerts use

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
git commit
short SHA = the image tag
evidence: git log

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Validate NEW steps
promtool check rules
kubeconform ServiceMonitor + PrometheusRule
dashboard JSON schema + PromQL parse
evidence: console log

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Build + scan + push
records image digest
evidence: image-manifest.json

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Verify digest
ECR digest must equal the one CI scanned
evidence: console log

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
helm upgrade
image tag + APP_VERSION / GIT_SHA env
the chart ships its ServiceMonitor
(alert rules are platform, not per-app)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
MONITORING GATE NEW
ask Prometheus, over a 3 min window:
1. all app targets up == 3?
2. 5xx ratio under the SLO burn threshold?
3. p95 latency under the SLO?
any answer no ⇒ helm rollback
evidence: gate output + rollback log

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Pod
image tag = the commit SHA
exposes :9090/metrics
evidence: kubectl get pods -o jsonpath
